objective: Test component parity only after exact one-ply tactical terminalization of immediate wins and unavoidable double-threat losses.

reduction.W: current mover has at least one immediate winning legal column
reduction.L: current mover has no immediate win and opponent has at least two distinct immediate winning columns

exactness_argument: W is exact by first-win stopping.
For L, any legal move occupies at most one landing column; with no immediate current-mover win, at least one distinct opponent immediate winning column remains for the next ply.
anti_circularity: W/L/O is computed from current q_o support plus singleton residuals only.
No solved value or future-class label defines the tactical status.
The post-RFG component definition and parity key are unchanged.
target: Q-V primary; Q-F recorded only as diagnostic
falsifiers: If MOD2_P_TACTICAL remains Q-V inconsistent, this exact tactical terminalization is not enough to make the current components self-cancelling.
A success would not prove a final XOR law; it would show that absorbing one-ply terminal structure was a necessary preprocessing layer in tested cases.
